messages:
maria_support: Customer acct 9142 reporting multiple card declines this morning. Says AVS mismatch flagged, CVV flagged too, but 3DS showed success on their side. Happening across two different BINs. Attaching logs and repro below.

jess_billing: thanks — can you paste the gateway response and the billing addr we sent? also need invoice/PO number if any.

maria_support: paste from our webhook (sensitive fields masked):
```json
{
  \"payment_id\": \"pay_01Gxyz9\",\n  \"customer_id\": \"9142\",\n  \"amount\": 24900,\n  \"currency\": \"usd\",\n  \"last4\": \"4242\",\n  \"avs_result\": \"N\",\n  \"cvv_result\": \"N\",\n  \"three_d_secure\": \"passed\",\n  \"decline_code\": \"card_declined\",\n  \"issuer_message\": \"AVS mismatch - check address\"\n}
```

maria_support: Billing addr sent: 1234 W Maple Ave Apt #5B, Springfield, IL 62704. Customer says bank expects "1234 W Maple Ave, Springfield, IL 62704" (no apt). Not a PO.

ramon_payments: bank-level AVS logic can strip apartment/unit sometimes. If issuer matched street number+zip only, apt mismatch could flip AVS to N. Did we run address normalization recently?

eva_engineer: we rolled out the new normalize_addresses pipeline last deploy (2026-01-14). It trims punctuation and normalizes "Apt" to "Apt" but there was a bug that dropped trailing # tokens in some cases. Investigating whether apt tokens were removed before sending to the gateway.

jess_billing: steps for repro we need: raw request body to gateway (headers ok to mask), webhook response (you pasted), and payments table row. rama/engineer can you run quick SQL?

ramon_payments: running query now:
```sql
SELECT id, payment_id, billing_line1, billing_line2, billing_city, billing_zip, created_at
FROM payments
WHERE customer_id = '9142'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

ramon_payments: result (masked): billing_line1=\"1234 W Maple Ave Apt 5B\", billing_line2=NULL, billing_zip=\"62704\" — so we did store the apt. Need to see what was sent to gateway.

maria_support: forwarding raw outbound post to gateway from logs (headers removed):
```http
POST /v1/payments
Host: gateway.example
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"amount\": 24900,
  \"currency\": \"usd\",
  \"card\": {\"number\": \"**** **** **** 4242\", \"exp_month\": \"09\", \"exp_year\": \"2027\"},
  \"billing_address\": {\"line1\": \"1234 W Maple Ave\", \"line2\": \"Apt 5B\", \"city\": \"Springfield\", \"zip\": \"62704\"}
}
```

ramon_payments: interesting — our outbound shows line1 without apt and line2 holds the unit. Some gateways expect apt in line1. If gateway concatenates line1+line2 in one way and the issuer normalizes differently, could produce mismatch. Also some issuers ignore line2.

jess_billing: customer provided their bank reference showing decline reason "AVS mismatch (street number)" and a trace id. We should escalate to gateway with full evidence. For immediate mitigation: try a retry with billing_address_override copying apt into line1: 
```json
{
  \"billing_address\": {\"line1\": \"1234 W Maple Ave Apt 5B\", \"line2\": \"\", \"city\": \"Springfield\", \"zip\": \"62704\"}
}
```

maria_support: did a manual retry with override and card went through. Customer confirmed success.

eva_engineer: root cause likely address normalization/formatting mismatch with issuer expectations. I'll open a patch to ensure we send combined line1 when line2 is non-empty for gateways that prefer single-line street. Adding feature flag + feature test.

ramon_payments: also recommended to log gateway-normalized address and AVS tokens for 30 days for faster triage.

jess_billing: opened escalation ticket with gateway (P-47211) and added merchant note about PO/billing address format. Routing to payments eng for permanent fix. :white_check_mark:

stripe_webhook_bot: Ticket P-47211 created and linked to contact at gateway, ETA 48h for initial response.

maria_support: customer notified. Closing loop once patch merges. Thanks team :thumbsup:
